1219	He said to me, What, Ben Zion, I saw that face, I said, whom did you send today?	Ele me disse: Então, Ben Zion, eu vi aquela cara e pensei: quem você mandou hoje?
1220	But the Rabbi opened his mouth, and what words of Torah came out of his mouth, a wonder	Mas o rabino abriu a boca, e que palavras de Torá saíram de sua boca, uma maravilha
1221	and a marvel.	e tanto.
